verdict.rationale: Nix's CLI commands (nix-env --upgrade, nix build, nix develop, nix-shell --run) are inherently non-interactive and scriptable, supporting agent-driven dependency installs/updates, and nix-env --rollback offers a safe recovery path on failure. However, there is no documentation of exit code conventions or structured/clear error output, and community feedback notes errors can require deep debugging rather than being clear (nix-comm-8), which cuts against the 'clear exit codes and errors' requirement. Missing for 10: explicit exit-code/error-message documentation, evidence of machine-readable or agent-friendly error output, and confirmation that update/install commands fail predictably without interactive prompts.
